doc.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21

title: Mugsy's early swing band with Sig Meyer
summary: Mugsy recalls one of the first swing bands in Chicago, led by violinist Sig Meyer.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah, I wouldn't mind a little cup of coffee. If you have an extra cup then. Sure. What do you want in it? Just a little sugar and cream. See, we had one of the first swing bands in Chicago, you know. Worked with Sig Meyer and some hands off. It was a good band. How big was the band? How much sugar do you want? One and a half, right? One, two, three, five, seven, ten pieces. Sig Meyer, he played the violin, he was the leader. It was a very good band. Was it a reading band arrangements and so on? Oh yes. You know I worked with old someone? Muggs? Wrath. That's it.
